fields.description: Issue features an investigative report alleging abuse and racketeering by "Torture Doctor" Dr. T. Earl Moore, including claims of violence against a boy patient and earlier abuse of a 13-year-old girl; additional coverage includes editorials on anti-communist publicity, Miami City Commission actions regarding annexation south of 119th Street and Biscayne Key, reports and commentary on gambling and conduct at the Dade County Fair (including a postcard scheme selling the title of the "Stop the Music" mystery tune), local court items, legal notices, and discussion of relocating/removing the FEC railroad station and tracks from downtown Miami.
